scope: Public-disclosure Work only; protected local route remains a separate existing protocol. No Luna alias, credential mount, global settings write or fallback.
base: R1 WorkerSpec/envelope/session/tool receipts unchanged; guest-runtime/2 directory mounts and actor authority/deadline callback retained
reuse: Pinned OMP18.8.6 Pi Native canonical Context and final AssistantMessage, not OpenAI message translation. Native SDK model lookup and max-effort normalization are authoritative. Existing Pi Native client/stream machinery must be reused.

host_bridge.transport: Owned stdin/stdout JSONL child, not a public listener or second agent/tool loop

configure.sdk_package_root: absolute pinned host Darwin SDK root
configure.auth_file: Root-selected existing credential reference; read no-follow, snapshot in RAM, do not print/copy to guest/rewrite source auth

ready.resolved_reasoning: actual pinned SDK maximum effort; not guessed or downgraded

response.message_json: exact genuine final AssistantMessage JSON or null

guest_config.resolved_reasoning: Root-provided SDK maximum from bridge ready

guest_wire.request: same broker request envelope version1 with UUID/execution/epoch/payload_json/payload_sha256; payload is native {modelId: exact provider-qualified selector,context,options,stream:true}
guest_wire.options: only maxTokens pinned1024 and reasoning pinned resolved maximum; no headers/apiKey/metadata/routing/fallback/functions/exec handlers or arbitrary endpoint
guest_wire.response: host bridge model_response envelope; complete private response files immutable, bounded4MiB message and64KiB envelope overhead

model_behavior: One native SDK generation per original request. Consume stream/result without executing tools on Host. Native SSE only transport, no websocket alternative; request-level one-shot fetch and no provider/session fallback or replay. Preserve opaque native thinking/tool signatures; do not synthesize an answer or fake successful response. If preconditions, credentials, model, effort or SDK controls are missing, reject visibly before dispatch.
delivery: Guest wrapper emits authentic final AssistantMessage through existing pinned native stream machinery, without serializing redundant O(N squared) partial snapshots. This bounded whole-call transport does not claim live token delivery. Validate final exact provider/model, allowed tool names, structure and hash before exposing it to OMP.

C2d: apps/ghost-omp/guest-model.ts shared descriptor-safe file transport extraction only
Root: Host admission and all registration/callers/auth capture/verification

integration: Root reuses existing durable broker authorization/dedup/journal and exact actor scope; pending request remains effect_unknown on crash/reopen and is never sent again. Cancel/fence revokes before backend/late delivery, retains drain ownership and never grants a new request ID. All affected source/callers migrate on cutover; transitional native same-UID public route cannot count as final acceptance.
verification: Root real exact Luna/max Linux OMP read/write/artifact/session plus revoke/fence/escape and public Host acceptance. Source, catalog, mock auth and forensic collection are not entitlement or acceptance proof. No helper model calls, tests/builds/deployment or auth reads outside its implementation session until explicit Root slot.
